description: 1. Run `am identity generate --name analyst` to create the analyst identity. 2. Run `am identity generate --name coordinator` to create the coordinator identity. 3. Run `am relay add wss://relay.damus.io` and `am relay add wss://nos.lol` to register both relay endpoints. 4. Run `am config set default_identity coordinator` to make coordinator the default — this is the key proprietary step many agents will miss or do incorrectly. 5. Pipe the analysis_task_payload JSON to `am send --identity coordinator --to npub1qqqqxyz9partner... ` (using either inline JSON or stdin pipe). The `--identity coordinator` flag must be explicit OR coordinator must already be the default at send time. 6. Run `am listen --once --limit 5` and parse the resulting NDJSON (one JSON object per line, NOT a JSON array) to extract the `content` field from each of the 5 messages, parse each content string as JSON, and write the resulting array of 5 objects to task_responses.json. The critical traps: (a) using `--format text` which breaks JSON parsing, (b) not understanding NDJSON vs JSON array format and failing to collect all 5, (c) forgetting `--identity coordinator` or not setting default_identity first, (d) sending raw string instead of JSON-parsed content objects to task_responses.json.
